text: APPROVE. `AppendStar` reproduces every branch of the original `*` handling (single `*` gives `[^/]*`, `**/` gives `(?:[^/]*/)*` and consumes 2 extra characters, trailing `**` gives `.*` and consumes 1), `i += AppendStar(sb, glob, i)` is safe because `i` is passed by value, and moving the nested branches out drops `ToRegex` well below 15 without introducing anything likely to trip warnings-as-errors.
